precision_policy.scope: BF16 input, exact source-precision FP8/UE8M0 group32 quantization, then BF16 encoded A8W8 projection with original replicated layer0 wq_a. No activation-distortion, full-model, cache, dispatch, collective, or performance acceptance.

overrides.row0_first64: Existing test_quantization FP8 ties/signed-zero literals, divided by64. The second group is twice the first.
overrides.row2_row3: dense pattern and its exact negative
overrides.row4: Two BF16-exact values +1,-1 at the first lexicographic equal nonzero decoded weight pair in output0 across distinct group32 blocks; zero elsewhere.
overrides.row128: alternating +/-2**-40, below half the minimum decoded value at the FP8 amax floor

input.requests: one independent row per request, with absolute budgets per row
input.empty: rows0 is a shape/lifecycle check without another stored golden

quantization.arithmetic: BF16 source values; FP32 max(abs(x),1e-4) times FP32(1/448), ceil power-of-two UE8M0 scale; FP32 division then finite E4M3 RN-even; BF16 reconstructed roundtrip.

invalid_recipe.cleared: encoded32 bytes, one scale byte, and roundtrip32 BF16 words all positive zero; all other groups unchanged
invalid_recipe.recovery: invalid then valid on the same workspace; poison all outputs before Eager and each Graph replay
invalid_recipe.acceptance: A nonzero status rejects the composed result; no valid-projection comparison or acceptance for invalid input

product.reference: Full FP64 decode(encoded A,row32 UE8M0) @ decode(original W,dense32 UE8M0).T
product.justification: Reuse the existing fixed encoded-product engineering envelope unchanged. Quantization bytes/scales/roundtrip/status are exact. Comparing to encoded operands excludes activation quantization distortion. Exact constructed zero endpoints additionally use1e-6 absolute cap.

precision_policy.storage: One generic Case/Fixture master; prefix view definitions and fixed limits share the master arrays. Original weights remain checkpoint-bound, with exact raw weight/scale hashes. No duplicated matrices or original checkpoint payload in the bundle.
precision_policy.provenance: Authenticate full manifest before parse; verify whole touched shard before returning selected raw values. Bind controls, source weight/scale records and raw hashes, original projection gate, generator/policy/import closure, environment and protected15. Portable names in the index; invocation and local paths only in external provenance.
